text: Aditi's knee surgery is booked for November 12th. Remind me to text her the evening before to wish her luck.
Lwazi is out of hospital as of Sunday. He's staying at his sister Kiara's place until he can manage the stairs again.
Joe mentioned his dad has a cataract operation sometime next week. Joe is driving him in and seems quite anxious about it.
Siobhan's gallbladder op got cancelled again, the third time now. They're saying early December instead, but nobody's confirmed a date.
Pick up the prescription before the pharmacy closes on Friday.
Arturo is a big Formula 1 fan and follows McLaren religiously. Also learning to make sourdough, apparently with mixed results.
Tariq had his hernia repair on 10/14. Need to check in with him the week after to see how the recovery is going.
Petra and Emre are off to Lisbon over the summer for their tenth anniversary. She wants it to be a surprise for the kids, so mum's the word.
Coffee with Oscar this morning. His wife Mai is expecting their second in the spring, and he's already panicking about sleep.
Graham's MRI results should be back by the end of the month. Don't forget to ring him once he's heard.
Björn is vegetarian and can't stand mushrooms. Worth remembering for the dinner.

Anil's mum fell last week and broke her wrist. She's in a cast for six weeks and staying with Anil and his wife for now, which means the kids are sharing a room and nobody is sleeping. He sounded exhausted on the phone. She has a fracture clinic check sometime around mid-November, and if it's healing properly she can go home before Christmas.
Ellie starts physio sometime next month for her shoulder. She's been putting it off since the summer.
Remind me to send Callum a card the day before his heart procedure on December 3rd. He's been very quiet about the whole thing, which usually means he's worried.
Aneesh says he's finally having his wisdom teeth out after Christmas. Thinks it'll be fine but I'm not so sure.
Alana's grandad passed away on Tuesday. The funeral is probably early next month, the family are still sorting it out.
Need to book my own flu jab soon. Clinic does walk-ins on Thursdays.
Anan just got the all clear after his scan. Massive relief for everyone, especially his partner Luis.
Ruby Nakamura from accounts is off for a few weeks from mid-November for an operation on her back. I'm covering her month-end reports.
Ali's daughter has her tonsils out on January 8th. Remind me to drop round some ice lollies that evening.
Shira's been in and out of hospital since September with her Crohn's. She's back at work part time but clearly struggling. I should take her for lunch sometime next week.
Chen has a hearing test on 11/2. Probably nothing, but his boss insisted.
Ava's dog Biscuit had a lump removed yesterday. Vet says it was benign, thankfully. She was in bits beforehand.
Elif mentioned she'd love a decent pair of noise-cancelling headphones for the hospital waiting rooms. Good gift idea for her birthday in early March.
Yuki had her baby! Little girl, born on the 17th. Mother and baby both doing well, home by the weekend. Must send flowers and a card.
Tadhg's back in for a follow-up appointment at the fracture clinic on the 29th. If the bone's healed he can finally ditch the crutches.
Called Uncle Sunil. He's recovering well from the bypass, walking twenty minutes a day now. Auntie says he's been grumpy because he can't have salt.
Aaliyah got her date for the hip replacement: February 20th. She's actually relieved, after two years of waiting. Remind me to visit her the week after, once she's home.
Dentist moved my appointment to sometime the week of the 10th. They'll call to confirm.

Lwazi Brennan, Zee to his rugby mates, is running the Cape Town marathon in the spring. First one, and he's nervous about his knee holding up after the cartilage surgery last year. He's seeing a sports physio every fortnight until then and has cut out drinking completely, which his girlfriend Aditi finds hilarious.
Joe and his partner are having their housewarming at the end of the month. I'm bringing dessert.
Kiara says her father-in-law is having a stent fitted sometime this week. She's flying out to Dublin to be with her husband's family, back around the 28th.
Petra works night shifts in A&E at the Royal, so don't call before noon.
Emre has his driving test on May 14. Remind me to message him good luck the night before and then that afternoon to see how he got on.

Spent ages on the phone with Siobhan. Her mum is going in for a mastectomy in early January and the whole family is rattled. Siobhan is trying to hold it together for her younger brother Tadhg, who doesn't cope well with hospitals. She's taking a week off work around the operation and might need someone to feed her cat Pepper. I said I'd help with that, and I should check in with her the day after the op either way.

Arturo's appendix burst over the weekend. Emergency surgery on Saturday night, home on Wednesday. His partner Petra said it was terrifying, he'd been brushing off the pain for two days. He wants to be back on the bike by Christmas, which feels optimistic. Remind me to drop off some soup and the box set I promised him on Friday evening.
Quick catch-up with Oscar. He's moving to Leeds sometime in the new year for a job at the university.
Tariq said Sato-san, his old judo coach, is in hospital with pneumonia. I think Tariq is going to visit him on Sunday.
Don't forget to ask Graham how his wife's knee scan went. It was meant to be last Thursday.
Björn's wedding has been called off. He and Ruby split up a few weeks ago and he's only just told people. Sounds like he's doing okay, but worth checking on him.
Anil collects vintage fountain pens. Mentioned a Parker 51 he's been hunting for ages.
Groceries, bin day is Tuesday this week, and the car needs an MOT before the end of November.
Ellie's surgery went well this morning! They kept her in overnight just to be safe. Text her tomorrow to see how she's feeling.

Callum and his wife Alana are off to Japan on June 3rd for three weeks, Tokyo first and then down to Kyoto and Hiroshima. He's been learning Japanese on Duolingo for a year in preparation and is very proud of his 400-day streak. Alana is more excited about the food. Ask him for photos when they're back, and maybe lend him my rail pass guide.
Aneesh's son starts nursery after Easter. Aneesh is the one dreading it more than the boy.
Luis had a gastroscopy on Monday and is waiting for biopsy results, maybe two weeks. He's trying not to think about it. Need to call him sometime next week, and again when the results are back.
Mai is training for a half marathon in the autumn and has just started running with a club on Saturday mornings.

Went with Ruby to meet Dr Lee today, her consultant. Nice man, very calm. Ruby goes in for her spinal fusion on 3/9, and he reckons she'll be in for five days, then six to eight weeks off work. She asked loads of questions but was shaking by the end. Her brother Oscar is taking her in on the day. I need to call her the night before.

Ali's wife Shira is having IVF again in the new year. They're both trying to stay positive after last time, but Ali admitted he's not sleeping well. Their first appointment at the clinic is January 9th, then egg collection sometime in February if everything goes to plan. Don't bring it up unless they do.
Remind me to call Chen the week after his hospital stay. His operation is pencilled in for some time in late January, but the date keeps moving, so I'll update this.

Ava's sister Elif is getting married in Istanbul sometime over the summer, probably late July. Ava is a bridesmaid and terrified about the speech, mostly because half the guests only speak Turkish. Elif has asked for donations to a honeymoon fund rather than gifts. I should put something aside for that, and ask Ava for the exact date once it's confirmed.

Yuki's husband had a minor stroke last month. He's home now and doing rehab three times a week, and his speech is coming back slowly. Yuki has gone back to work but is shattered, and her boss isn't being very understanding about the hospital runs. Their son Callum is home from uni for reading week at the end of the month, which should help a bit.
Lovely evening with Tadhg and Aditi. They've adopted a rescue greyhound called Pip and are completely smitten.

Kiara said her nan's ninetieth is on April 22nd. The family are throwing a big lunch, and Kiara wants a photo book made. Remind me to dig out the old pictures from the reunion a couple of weeks before.
Sunil had his colonoscopy on Friday and everything came back clear. He was dreading it for weeks.
Aaliyah Reyes is a nurse at St Mary's, on the cardiology ward. Lives in Clapham with two flatmates.
Nothing much from today's call with Joe, just football and the weather.

Petra has an ultrasound sometime next week to check on the twins. Then the 20-week scan around the end of November. I should send her a message after the first one to see how it went, and maybe drop off dinner the same evening.
Tariq's sister Aaliyah is having a C-section on 7/15, a few weeks early because of her blood pressure. Tariq is flying over from Toronto the day before. He's worried but trying not to show it.
Need to sort the spare room before Mum comes to stay after her cataract surgery in early February.
